name: Spell Check Suggestions Toolbar
description: Upstream-parity shadcn spell check suggestions toolbar (SpellCheckSuggestionsToolbar + .editableText) rendered through registry menu primitives.

use: you enable spell check on text fields and want shadcn styling.
you need the editableText toolbar constructor for framework integration.
avoid: plain text fields without spell check configuration.

theming: Inherits menu popup theming from the `menu` component.
accessibility: Suggestion buttons expose their replacement text as labels.
dont: Show more than three suggestions at once.
